question: Which deposited identifier and annotation ambiguities underlie the repeated nonempty symbol labels?
decision: Determine whether deposited annotations admit unambiguous symbol-to-record identity, without remapping or biological ranking.
strongest_rival: Repeated symbols refer to distinct deposited loci or annotation records rather than duplicate copies of one stable identifier.
discriminator: Compare only nine annotation fields across source tables and diagnose identifier multiplicity, version suffixes and locus metadata.
exposure_record: The published outcomes and R1 QC were previously reviewed, including 52 repeated labels and 122 affected rows. Source headers and three annotation rows were inspected before this freeze; no expression values are selected.
biological_unit: Deposited annotation row; not an animal or independent biological replicate.
nesting_and_overlap: Count and FPKM files reuse the same deposited annotation records and samples; their agreement is not replication.
population_and_selection: Every annotation row from both declared GSE160217 tables; project the exact nine declared metadata columns only.
contrast: Rowwise metadata consistency and identifier multiplicity; no expression or treatment comparison.
endpoint: Annotation identity, version suffix presence, repeated-symbol cardinality, coordinate/strand validity and field consistency.
methods: Standard-library gzip/CSV projection, exact rowwise comparison, regex identifier diagnostics and metadata counters; preserve row order and all annotations.
missingness_and_exclusions: No rows excluded or collapsed. Empty fields and invalid coordinates are reported; no external mappings or annotation release inferred.
multiplicity: No biological tests or significance calculations; deterministic metadata checks only.
precision_basis: No biological estimate or precision claim is computed.
interpretation_limit: Annotation ambiguity cannot establish gene function, receptor response, target priority or treatment effects.
stop_rule: Reject missing/duplicate headers, malformed rows or discrepant annotations across source files. Do not relax checks or inspect expression to repair annotation.
amendment_reason: Initial prospective source-only extension; R1 remains immutable and biological execution holds remain unchanged.
